Here is the GMS1 filled in for your daughter (P3), with you signing on her behalf.

Patient's details
[B01] Title: NEEDS-YOU. No title is listed for her. For a girl you would usually tick Miss, or you can leave it blank. Tick it by hand.
[B02] Surname: SURNAME_P3
[B03] Date of birth: DATE_P3
[B04] First names: GIVEN_P3
[B05] NHS No.: leave blank. She has never been registered with a GP, so she probably doesn't have one yet. If she does have one, NEEDS-YOU: write it in by hand.
[B06] Previous surname/s: leave blank, unless she has had a different surname. If she has, NEEDS-YOU.
[B07] [✔] Female
[B08] Town and country of birth: PLACE_P3
[B09] Home address: ADDRESS_P1
[B10] Postcode: ADDRESS_P1
[B11] Telephone number: PHONE_P1 (she has no phone number listed, so this is yours as her parent. Use PHONE_P2 instead if her mother should be the contact.)

Previous medical records
[B12] Your previous address in UK: leave blank if she has always lived at your current address. If she lived at another UK address before, NEEDS-YOU.
[B13] Name of previous doctor while at that address: leave blank (never registered with a GP).
[B14] Address of previous doctor: leave blank (never registered with a GP).

If you are from abroad (fill in only if she moved to the UK from abroad)
[B15] Your first UK address where registered with a GP: ADDRESS_P1 (this is her first GP registration)
[B16] If previously resident in UK, date of leaving: leave blank if she never lived in the UK before. Otherwise, NEEDS-YOU.
[B17] Date you first came to live in UK: NEEDS-YOU. This date isn't listed.
If she was born in the UK or has always lived here, leave B15 to B17 blank.

If you are returning from the Armed Forces
[B18] to [B20]: leave blank (doesn't apply).

If you are registering a child under 5
[B21] NEEDS-YOU. I can't see her date of birth, so I can't tell her age. If she is under 5, tick this box to sign her up for Child Health Surveillance.

Dispensing
[B22] Leave both boxes blank, unless one of them is true for you.

Signature
[B23] [✔] Signature on behalf of patient. Sign it yourself by hand.
[B24] Date: NEEDS-YOU. Write the date you sign, by hand.

Things to do by hand once the values are filled in:
- The form asks for BLOCK CAPITALS. If any value comes back in lower case, rewrite it in capitals on the paper form.
- B03: the date comes back as it is printed in her passport. If it isn't in day/month/year order with numbers (for example 05/03/2019), rewrite it that way.
- B04: the form asks for all her first names. If she has a middle name, add it after GIVEN_P3.
- B08: if PLACE_P3 shows only a town, add her country of birth after it.
- B09 and B10: your address is in one piece. In B10, keep only the postcode and cross out the rest. In B09, you can then remove the postcode so it isn't written twice.
- B11: if the practice wants a number in UK format, check the country code and spacing of the number by hand.
- The practice may ask to see her passport and proof of your address when you hand the form in.
